tokens.empty: No token traffic recorded in this range yet. History builds up while sparkDash is running.
tokens.historyBuilds: sparkDash records token counters while it runs, so history builds up over time. Send a request to a local LLM endpoint and check back in a minute or two.
tokens.noCacheHits: This engine does not report prefix-cache hits
tokens.insightBusiest: The busiest {{unit}} was {{when}} with {{tokens}} tokens, {{share}} of {{period}}.
tokens.insightCacheUnmeasured: None of the {{prompt}} prompt tokens was measured: they were read before the engine reported its prefix cache.
tokens.insightCacheUnavailable: This engine does not publish a prefix-cache counter, so the cache hit rate cannot be measured.
tokens.insightCachePartial: The prefix cache served {{rate}} of the {{measured}} prompt tokens it was measured on ({{unreported}} more were not reported).
tokens.insightCacheSaved: The prefix cache served {{rate}} of prompt tokens, so about {{cached}} prefill tokens did not have to be recomputed.
tokens.insightCacheNone: No prompt tokens were served from the prefix cache.
tokens.insightDominantModel: {{model}} dominates, handling {{share}} of all tokens across {{count}} models.
tokens.insightSpreadModels: Traffic is spread across {{count}} models; the busiest, {{model}}, has {{share}}.
tokens.insightWorkload: For every generated token, {{promptPerGenerated}} prompt tokens were read: {{shape}}.
tokens.insightIdle: {{idle}} of the {{completed}} completed {{unit}}s in {{period}} had no traffic at all.
tokens.insightTopSpark: {{spark}} served {{share}} of all tokens, the most of {{count}} Sparks.
tokens.aboutBuckets: Daily buckets are UTC days; hourly buckets are UTC hours shown in the time zone from Settings (browser default).
tokens.aboutRestart: Counters that go backwards (an engine restart) are re-seeded from the new value, so a restart never inflates totals. Tokens served right before a restart can be missed.
tokens.aboutLifetime: All time is the lifetime total since tracking began; its chart shows the retained daily buckets.
tokens.aboutLifetimeFallback: All time is unavailable right now, so the retained days are summed instead; its chart shows the retained daily buckets.
tokens.cacheSaved: The prefix cache saved {{cached}} prefill tokens
tokens.promptPerGenerated: {{value}} prompt tokens read per token generated

table.cacheUnreported: This engine does not report prefix-cache hits
table.byEndpoint: Token totals by Spark and endpoint

tokens.shapeVeryInput: a very input-heavy workload (long prompts, short answers)
tokens.shapeBalanced: a fairly balanced mix of input and output
tokens.previousIncomplete: No change-vs-previous figures are shown because the previous period was not fully tracked.
tokens.retention: Hourly history is kept for {{hours}} hours and daily history for {{days}} days. The hourly view only has data from when it was first recorded.
tokens.accounting: Generated = tokens the model wrote. Prompt = tokens it read. Cached prefill is the part of the prompt served from the prefix cache; computed prefill is the rest. Prompt read while the engine published no prefix-cache counter is shown as not reported: it is neither cached nor computed, and the hit rate covers only the prompt whose split was measured.

energy.subtitle: Estimated electricity use of your Sparks from GPU and CPU power telemetry. Not wall-metered.
energy.resetNote: Power keeps being recorded from now on, and monthly history is kept. This can't be undone.
energy.membershipChangedText: Sparks were added or removed since energy accounting started, so totals would no longer be comparable. Restart sparkDash to start a new accounting scope. Previous hourly history is withheld until then.
energy.noEnergy: No energy recorded in the last {{range}}
energy.chartAria: Energy in kWh per {{unit}} by node, last {{range}}
energy.powerChartAria: Average fleet power in watts per hour, last {{range}}
energy.efficiencyHint: Wh per 1,000 generated tokens, per {{unit}}. Lower is better; idle time counts.
energy.tableCaption: Energy by node for the last {{range}}
energy.insightTop: {{node}} uses the most energy: {{kwh}} kWh, {{share}}% of the fleet total{{wattsSuffix}}{{spreadSuffix}}
energy.insightDay: {{day}} was the highest-use day with {{kwh}} kWh, {{above}}% above the {{average}} kWh average of well-covered days.
energy.insightNightLower: Overnight (22:00 to 06:00 local) the fleet averaged {{night}}, {{change}}% lower than the {{day}} daytime average.
energy.insightNightHigher: Overnight (22:00 to 06:00 local) the fleet averaged {{night}}, {{change}}% higher than the {{day}} daytime average.
energy.insightSteady: Draw is steady around the clock: {{night}} overnight versus {{day}} during the day.
energy.insightCost: At {{price}} per kWh, this pace would cost about {{weekly}} per week. This is a rough extrapolation from the data recorded so far, not a forecast.
energy.insightEfficiency: The fleet generated about {{tokens}} output tokens per kWh ({{wh}} Wh per 1,000 tokens), counting idle time in the same hours.

monthly.title: Monthly history
monthly.subtitle: Totals per UTC month, kept permanently. They survive resets, restarts and changes to the fleet. Months are UTC, so they will not match a local-time electricity bill.
monthly.empty: Nothing archived yet. Each finished minute is added to its month once the Sparks have been reporting for a little while.

energy.title: Fleet energy
energy.warmingText: No complete energy interval has been recorded yet. Data appears here once every node has reported fresh power telemetry for a little while.
energy.stale: Could not refresh just now; showing the last data received.
energy.estimatedNotice: Estimated, not metered. Figures are integrated from GPU and CPU power readings and leave out power-supply losses and other components, so the wall draw is somewhat higher.
energy.noEarlier: No earlier period to compare yet
energy.setPrice: Set an electricity price in Settings
energy.noTokenData: No token data in this range
energy.tryLonger: Try a longer range, or check that the Sparks are reporting power telemetry.
energy.powerSubtitle: Watts per hour while every node reported. Gaps mean no full-fleet coverage.
energy.nodeSubtitle: Each node is measured only while it reports, so coverage differs per node.
energy.costHelp: Cost needs an electricity price; set one in Settings.
energy.insightsEmpty: Insights appear once there is enough recorded data in this range.

notes.estimated: Energy is power telemetry (GPU + CPU) integrated over time, not a wall meter reading.
notes.gaps: Hours with no telemetry are left out, never filled in. Coverage is the share of time every node reported fresh data; per-node coverage is in the table.
notes.efficiency: only counts tokens and energy from time when all nodes were reporting.
notes.retention: Hourly history is kept for 31 days. Longer ranges show what exists so far.
notes.localTime: Hours and days follow the time zone in Settings, or this browser's by default ({{zone}}). Hourly rows are stored in UTC.
notes.membership: Adding or removing a Spark starts a new accounting scope after a sparkDash restart.
